b. In terms of bonds broken and bonds made, explain why this is an exothermic reaction. (2 marks)

Energy needed to break bonds is less than energy released when forming bonds (1)

Therefore net release of energy (1)

c. If a gas cylinder contains 45.0 kg of propane, how much energy (in kilojoules) can be produced by the combustion of the gas? (4 marks)

M(C₃H₈) = 44.094 g mol⁻¹ (1 mark).

m(C₃H₈) = 45.0 kg = 45 000 g (1 mark).

n(C₃H₈) = 45 000 / 44.094 = 1.0205 × 10³ mol (1 mark).

Energy = 2202 × 1.0205 × 10³ = 2.25 × 10⁶ kJ (1 mark).
